description: Set one exact Home Assistant input_boolean state through the governed direct-provider lifecycle.

expected_effects: Set input_boolean.synthetic_standard_helper to the exact state on.

preconditions: The exact entity remains available as an input_boolean.
The planned state fingerprint remains current, or the desired state is already observed.
The normalized dependency-risk evidence remains execution-eligible and unchanged.
One unexpired external administrator approval is bound to this plan hash.

reasons: Consequence evidence is incomplete or semantically opaque; downstream household effects remain unknown.
warnings: The exact helper dispatch contract is executable only after an owner accepts the disclosed consequence uncertainty and conservative locks.
